price_streams.technical_signal_bars: BID_OHLC built causally from Darwinex Bid ticks
price_streams.buy_entry: first executable Ask after signal event
price_streams.sell_entry: first executable Bid after signal event

bar_availability.tick_break: boundary and all filter state must be known before triggering tick; ATR/filter values use the last completed signal bar
bar_availability.close_break: signal is evaluated after the signal bar completes; indicators may include that just-completed bar; fill occurs on the next executable quote
bar_availability.multi_tf: latest fully closed higher-timeframe bar available strictly before entry

fractal_generalization.window: odd integer N; k=floor(N/2); candidate pivot is bar t-k when bar t closes
fractal_generalization.SOURCE_ASYMMETRIC_high: pivot >= every older/left neighbor inside window AND pivot > every newer/right neighbor inside window
fractal_generalization.SOURCE_ASYMMETRIC_low: pivot <= every older/left neighbor inside window AND pivot < every newer/right neighbor inside window
fractal_generalization.STRICT_ALL_NEIGHBORS_high: pivot > every other high in the window
fractal_generalization.STRICT_ALL_NEIGHBORS_low: pivot < every other low in the window
fractal_generalization.first_usable_time: after confirmation event at close of bar t; plot offsets never change executable time

rearm_modes.RETURN_INSIDE_OR_LEVEL_REPLACED: after same-side signal, same side rearms only after price returns to or through the broken boundary in the opposite direction, or a new confirmed same-side boundary replaces it
rearm_modes.LEVEL_REPLACED_ONLY: same-side signal may recur only after a new confirmed same-side boundary replaces the signaled boundary
rearm_modes.ONE_SIGNAL_PER_LEVEL: each unique confirmed boundary may trigger once per side; replacement creates a new eligible level

breakout_and_retest.buy_threshold: confirmed fractal high + breakout_buffer_atr * ATR14 when buffer active; otherwise confirmed high
breakout_and_retest.sell_threshold: confirmed fractal low - breakout_buffer_atr * ATR14 when buffer active; otherwise confirmed low
breakout_and_retest.TICK_BREAK: first causal Bid transition from <= threshold to > threshold for BUY; from >= threshold to < threshold for SELL
breakout_and_retest.CLOSE_BREAK: completed Bid bar close crosses threshold in the side direction relative to previous completed close
breakout_and_retest.retest_arm: only after a valid breakout event
breakout_and_retest.TOUCH_RECLAIM: within configured completed-bar window, price touches/crosses back through boundary and subsequently reclaims it intrabar; entry only after reclaim event is observable
breakout_and_retest.CLOSE_RECLAIM: within configured completed-bar window, a completed bar trades through/touches boundary and closes back on breakout side; entry next executable quote
breakout_and_retest.boundary_replaced_during_retest: cancel pending retest and restart from the new confirmed boundary

indicator_formulas.EMA: source=CLOSE unless explicitly stated; alpha=2/(n+1); seed=SMA of first n completed bars; recursive thereafter
indicator_formulas.ATR: Wilder true range; RMA period n seeded by SMA of first n TR values
indicator_formulas.RSI14: Wilder RMA of gains/losses period 14; standard 0-100 definition
indicator_formulas.STOCH14_3: raw %K over 14 completed bars; SMA3 smoothing; BUY aligned when smoothed K>50, SELL aligned when K<50
indicator_formulas.ADX14: Wilder +DM/-DM/TR smoothing period14 followed by Wilder smoothing of DX period14; threshold is direction-neutral trend strength

trend_rules.EMA_ORDER_SLOPE: EMA_ORDER plus each EMA one-bar slope sign aligned with side
trend_rules.PRICE_EMA_ORDER_SLOPE: PRICE_EMA_ORDER plus each EMA one-bar slope sign aligned with side
trend_rules.EMA_CROSS_RECENCY: fast/mid cross in side direction occurred within inclusive last N completed signal bars

dependency_defaults.ema_cross_when_TREND_active: use active TREND fast/mid EMA pair
dependency_defaults.mtf_trend_when_TREND_active: reuse active TREND mode/triple on context timeframe where meaningful; PRICE clause uses context close
dependency_defaults.mtf_trend_when_TREND_inactive: PRICE_EMA_ORDER with source 35/70/105 on context timeframe

context_timeframe_mapping.NEXT_HIGHER: first ladder timeframe strictly greater in duration than signal timeframe
context_timeframe_mapping.TWO_STEPS_HIGHER: second ladder timeframe strictly greater in duration than signal timeframe

session_semantics.LONDON_NY_OVERLAP: time intersection of LONDON and NY_RTH on each civil date using IANA DST rules

same_day_exit: close at last valid executable quote before source-clock trading date changes; if symbol session ends earlier, use last valid quote before that session break once session calendar is bound
execution_ambiguity_policy: SL first when SL and TP are reached ambiguously; gap uses first actually executable quote; crossed/invalid quotes cannot fill
